# Skibidi vs Ohio — Mini Invaders (Banner Edition, No Sound)

Arcade-style meme twist on Space Invaders, now with **top-of-screen celebration banners** and **no audio**.

## 🎮 How to Play
- **Choose your side:** Click **Play as Skibidi** (🚽) or **Play as Ohio** (🛑).
- **Move:** **Arrow Keys** (← →) or **A/D**
- **Shoot:** **Spacebar**
- **Audio:** None (per your request)

## 🧾 What’s New (vs SFX build)
- **Top Banners:** Short messages appear **above the game canvas** (outside the play box).
  - On start: “Skibidi rises!” or “Only in Ohio!”
  - On level up: “Skibidi go go go!” or “Yay Ohio!”
  - On life lost / game over: quick warning banners
- **No Sound:** All audio code removed.

## 🕹️ Objective
- Blast the opposing side’s invaders before they drop too low.
- Clear waves to increase **level** (they march faster).
- You have **3 lives**. Zero lives = **Game Over**.

Enjoy!
